## Why This Is Asked
Tests ability to implement multi-tenant zero-trust mTLS using SPIFFE IDs, short-lived cert rotation, and KMS-backed CA in CNF gateways.

## Key Concepts
- SPIFFE/SPIRE trust domains per tenant
- CSR-based certificate rotation with short lifetimes
- Per-tenant mesh policies (Istio/OPA) for north-south and east-west traffic
- Workload identity verification via SPIFFE IDs

## Code Example
```yaml
# CSR bootstrap (outline)
apiVersion: certificates.k8s.io/v1
kind: CertificateSigningRequest
metadata:
  name: gateway-td1-csr
spec:
  signerName: kubernetes.io/kube-apiserver-clientSigner
  request: <base64-csr>
  usages:
  - digital signature
  - key encipherment
  - client auth
```

```yaml
# Per-tenant policy (outline)
apiVersion: security.istio.io/v1beta1
kind: AuthorizationPolicy
metadata:
  name: tenant-td1-gateway
spec:
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: gateway
  rules:
  - from:
    - source:
        principals: ["spiffe://td1/ns/default/sa/gateway"]
    to:
    - operation:
        methods: ["GET","POST"]
```

## Follow-up Questions
- How would you handle cert revocation in case of a compromised gateway?
- How would you test cross-tenant isolation under peak load?

questions.explanation:
## Why This Is Asked
Real-world upgrades in multi-tenant CNF platforms require safe, isolated releases. This tests your ability to design rollout strategies, implement metrics-based promotion decisions, and enforce cross-tenant risk controls.

## Key Concepts
- Argo Rollouts canary strategy scoped per tenant
- Tenant isolation via labels and service mesh subsets
- Per-tenant AnalysisRun with Prometheus-based SLAs
- Rollback and auto-promotion guardrails
- Minimal CRD sketches and namespace-scoped validation

## Code Example
```yaml
apiVersion: argoproj.io/v1alpha1
kind: Rollout
metadata:
  name: gateway-rollout-tenant-a
  labels:
    tenant: a
spec:
  replicas: 3
  strategy:
    canary:
      steps:
        - setWeight: 10
        - analysis:
            templates:
              - templateName: tenant-a-analysis
        - setWeight: 30
        - analysis:
            templates:
              - templateName: tenant-a-analysis
        - setWeight: 100
      trafficRouting:
        nginx:
          stableIngress: gateway-ingress
          additionalIngressAnnotations:
            canary-by-header: X-Tenant-ID
      analysis:
        successfulRunHistoryLimit: 3
        unsuccessfulRunHistoryLimit: 3
```

## Per-Tenant AnalysisRun CRD Sketch
```yaml
apiVersion: argoproj.io/v1alpha1
kind: AnalysisTemplate
metadata:
  name: tenant-a-analysis
spec:
  args:
    - name: tenant-id
  metrics:
    - name: latency-sli
      interval: 1m
      successCondition: result[0] <= 100
      failureLimit: 3
      provider:
        prometheus:
          address: http://prometheus:9090
          query: |-
            histogram_quantile(0.99,
              sum(rate(gateway_request_duration_seconds_bucket{tenant="{{args.tenant-id}}"}[5m]))
              by (le))
    - name: error-rate-sli
      interval: 1m
      successCondition: result[0] <= 0.01
      failureLimit: 3
      provider:
        prometheus:
          address: http://prometheus:9090
          query: |-
            sum(rate(gateway_requests_total{tenant="{{args.tenant-id}},status=~"5.."}[5m]))
            /
            sum(rate(gateway_requests_total{tenant="{{args.tenant-id}}"}[5m]))
```

## One-Namespace Test Manifest
```yaml
apiVersion: v1
kind: Namespace
metadata:
  name: tenant-a-canary-test
  labels:
    tenant: a
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  name: gateway-stable
  namespace: tenant-a-canary-test
spec:
  ports:
    - port: 80
      targetPort: 8080
  selector:
    app: gateway
    role: stable
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  name: gateway-canary
  namespace: tenant-a-canary-test
spec:
  ports:
    - port: 80
      targetPort: 8080
  selector:
    app: gateway
    role: canary
---
apiVersion: argoproj.io/v1alpha1
kind: Rollout
metadata:
  name: gateway-rollout
  namespace: tenant-a-canary-test
  labels:
    tenant: a
spec:
  replicas: 2
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: gateway
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: gateway
    spec:
      containers:
        - name: gateway
          image: gateway:v2
          ports:
            - containerPort: 8080
  strategy:
    canary:
      canaryService: gateway-canary
      stableService: gateway-stable
      trafficRouting:
        service:
          canaryWeight: 10
      steps:
        - setWeight: 10
        - pause: {duration: 5m}
        - setWeight: 30
        - pause: {duration: 5m}
        - setWeight: 100
```

## Traffic Isolation Design
- **Service Mesh Subsets**: Each tenant gets dedicated subsets (stable/canary) in the mesh, ensuring zero cross-tenant traffic bleed
- **Tenant Labels**: All resources (Rollouts, Services, AnalysisRuns) are labeled with tenant ID for RBAC and policy enforcement
- **Network Policies**: Kubernetes NetworkPolicies restrict pod-to-pod communication to same-tenant pods only
- **Ingress Routing**: Use header-based routing (X-Tenant-ID) at the ingress to route to tenant-specific services

## Per-Tenant Metrics Collection
- Deploy tenant-scoped Prometheus instances or use Prometheus tenants
- Configure recording rules per tenant for SLI computation
- Metrics queries always include tenant filter to ensure isolation
- Store metrics with tenant label for multi-tenant querying and alerting

## Policy Enforcement
- **OPA/Gatekeeper**: Enforce that Rollouts must have tenant label and cannot modify other tenants' resources
- **Kubernetes RBAC**: Bind roles to tenant groups, limiting access to tenant-specific namespaces
- **Argo Rollouts RBAC**: Restrict Rollout/AnalysisTemplate access to tenant admins only

questions.explanation:
## Why This Is Asked
This question evaluates understanding of tenant isolation, mTLS, and certificate rotation using cert-manager in a CNF (Cloud-Native Function) gateway context. It also assesses practical knowledge of in-cluster secret management and sidecar integration patterns.

## Key Concepts
- Kubernetes Secrets and per-tenant namespace isolation
- Mutual TLS termination in a gateway sidecar
- cert-manager Issuers and automatic certificate rotation
- Tenant identity extraction from X.509 certificates

## Code Example
```yaml
# Per-tenant CA Issuer
apiVersion: cert-manager.io/v1
kind: Issuer
metadata:
  name: tenant-ca-issuer
  namespace: tenant-namespace
spec:
  ca:
    secretName: tenant-ca-cert
---
# Certificate with auto-rotation
apiVersion: cert-manager.io/v1
kind: Certificate
metadata:
  name: tenant-server-tls
  namespace: tenant-namespace
spec:
  secretName: tenant-<id>-tls
  issuerRef:
    name: tenant-ca-issuer
    kind: Issuer
  duration: 168h
  renewBefore: 72h
  dnsNames:
    - gateway.tenant-namespace.svc.cluster.local
  subject:
    organizations:
      - tenant-<id>
---
# Gateway Deployment with mTLS sidecar
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: cnf-gateway
  namespace: tenant-namespace
spec:
  template:
    spec:
      containers:
      - name: gateway
        ports:
        - containerPort: 8443
        volumeMounts:
        - name: tls-certs
          mountPath: /etc/tls
          readOnly: true
      - name: mtls-sidecar
        image: mtls-proxy:latest
        ports:
        - containerPort: 9443
        env:
        - name: TENANT_CA_PATH
          value: /etc/certs/ca.crt
        - name: VALIDATE_CLIENT_CERTS
          value: "true"
        volumeMounts:
        - name: tls-certs
          mountPath: /etc/tls
          readOnly: true
        - name: tenant-ca
          mountPath: /etc/certs
          readOnly: true
      volumes:
      - name: tls-certs
        secret:
          secretName: tenant-<id>-tls
      - name: tenant-ca
        secret:
          secretName: tenant-ca-cert
```

## Validation One-Namespace Manifest
```yaml
apiVersion: v1
kind: Namespace
metadata:
  name: tenant-001
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: Secret
metadata:
  name: tenant-ca-cert
  namespace: tenant-001
type: kubernetes.io/tls
data:
  tls.crt: <base64-encoded-ca-cert>
  tls.key: <base64-encoded-ca-key>
---
apiVersion: cert-manager.io/v1
kind: Issuer
metadata:
  name: tenant-ca-issuer
  namespace: tenant-001
spec:
  ca:
    secretName: tenant-ca-cert
---
apiVersion: cert-manager.io/v1
kind: Certificate
metadata:
  name: tenant-001-tls
  namespace: tenant-001
spec:
  secretName: tenant-001-tls
  issuerRef:
    name: tenant-ca-issuer
    kind: Issuer
  duration: 168h
  renewBefore: 72h
  dnsNames:
    - gateway.tenant-001.svc.cluster.local
  subject:
    organizations:
      - tenant-001
```

## Key Implementation Details
1. **Certificate Rotation**: cert-manager automatically renews certificates before expiration using the `renewBefore` field
2. **Tenant Isolation**: Each tenant has isolated namespaces, CAs, and TLS secrets
3. **mTLS Validation**: The sidecar validates client certificates against the tenant-specific CA
4. **Tenant ID Extraction**: The tenant ID is extracted from the certificate subject (organization field) to enforce access policies

questions.explanation:
## Why This Is Asked
This question assesses the ability to design per-tenant feature flag canary deployments in Cloud-Native Functions (CNFs), including CRD-driven configuration, deterministic traffic steering, rollback mechanisms, and observability considerations.

## Key Concepts
- Per-tenant feature flags via custom Kubernetes CRD
- Deterministic routing using HMAC hashing for consistent tenant-to-canary assignment
- Canary rollout semantics with percentage-based traffic splitting
- Rollback strategies and observability per tenant

## Solution Overview
The solution uses a TenantFlags CRD to define per-tenant feature flag configurations. The sidecar gateway computes HMAC-SHA256(tenantID + flag) to derive a hash value between 0-99. If this value is less than the rolloutPct, traffic routes to canaryPath; otherwise, it uses baselinePath.

### TenantFlags CRD
```yaml
apiVersion: cnf.example/v1
kind: TenantFlags
metadata:
  name: tenant-flags
  namespace: cnf-gateway
spec:
  tenants:
    - tenantId: "tenant-001"
      flags:
        - name: "new-payment-api"
          canaryPath: "/api/v2/payments"
          baselinePath: "/api/v1/payments"
          rolloutPct: 15
        - name: "enhanced-search"
          canaryPath: "/search/v2"
          baselinePath: "/search/v1"
          rolloutPct: 10
```

### Example Tenant Configuration
```yaml
apiVersion: cnf.example/v1
kind: TenantFlags
metadata:
  name: acme-corp-flags
  namespace: cnf-gateway
spec:
  tenants:
    - tenantId: "acme-corp"
      flags:
        - name: "graphql-schema"
          canaryPath: "/graphql/v2"
          baselinePath: "/graphql/v1"
          rolloutPct: 25
```

### One-Namespace Validation Manifest
```yaml
apiVersion: v1
kind: Namespace
metadata:
  name: cnf-gateway
---
apiVersion: apiextensions.k8s.io/v1
kind: CustomResourceDefinition
metadata:
  name: tenantflags.cnf.example
spec:
  group: cnf.example
  names:
    kind: TenantFlags
    plural: tenantflags
  scope: Namespaced
  versions:
    - name: v1
      served: true
      storage: true
      schema:
        openAPIV3Schema:
          type: object
          properties:
            spec:
              type: object
              properties:
                tenants:
                  type: array
                  items:
                    type: object
                    properties:
                      tenantId:
                        type: string
                      flags:
                        type: array
                        items:
                          type: object
                          properties:
                            name:
                              type: string
                            canaryPath:
                              type: string
                            baselinePath:
                              type: string
                            rolloutPct:
                              type: integer
                              minimum: 0
                              maximum: 100
```

## Rollback Considerations
- **Immediate Rollback**: Set rolloutPct to 0 to instantly redirect all traffic to baseline
- **CRD Removal**: Delete the flag from the TenantFlags spec to revert to baseline
- **Gradual Rollback**: Decrease rolloutPct incrementally (e.g., 25 → 15 → 5 → 0) for controlled recovery
- **Version History**: Maintain previous flag configurations in the CRD or external storage for audit purposes

## Observability Considerations
- **Metrics**: Emit per-tenant, per-flag metrics tracking canary vs baseline traffic ratios
- **Logging**: Include tenantID, flag name, and routing decision (canary/baseline) in access logs
- **Tracing**: Propagate tenant context through distributed traces to identify canary traffic patterns
- **Alerts**: Monitor error rates and latency differences between canary and baseline paths per tenant
- **Dashboards**: Visualize rollout progress and health metrics for each tenant's feature flags

## Why This Is Asked
Tests ability to architect cross-cluster, tenant-isolated config rollouts with dynamic proxy configuration.

## Key Concepts
- Envoy xDS dynamic configuration and Aggregated Discovery Service (ADS)
- Kubernetes CRD-based policy model per tenant with isolation
- Canary traffic shaping with weight and time-based rollout window
- Multi-cluster consistency and safe rollback mechanisms
- Observability hooks for validation during rollout phases

## Code Example
```yaml
# (a) Tenant Routing Policy with Canary Weight and Rollout Window
apiVersion: cnf.example/v1
kind: TenantRoutePolicy
metadata:
  name: tenant-a-api-v2
  namespace: tenant-a
spec:
  tenant: tenant-a
  targetCluster: cluster-west
  route:
    path: /api/v2
    backendRefs:
      - name: gateway-service
        port: 8080
  canary:
    weight: 0  # Start at 0%
    rolloutDuration: 30m
    stepWeight: 10  # Increment by 10% each step
    stepInterval: 5m
  rollback:
    enabled: true
    failureThreshold: 5  # Rollback if 5 consecutive errors exceed threshold
    errorRateThreshold: 0.05  # 5% error rate triggers rollback
  healthCheck:
    endpoint: /healthz
    interval: 30s
    timeout: 10s
---
# (b) Sidecar Config to Watch Policy and Push Updates
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: envoy-gateway-sidecar
  namespace: gateway-system
spec:
  template:
    spec:
      containers:
        - name: xds-controller
          image: cnf/xds-controller:latest
          args:
            - --policy-namespace=tenant-a
            - --xds-address=$(POD_IP):18000
            - --sync-interval=10s
          env:
            - name: POD_IP
              valueFrom:
                fieldRef:
                  fieldPath: status.podIP
          volumeMounts:
            - name: policy-config
              mountPath: /etc/policy
              readOnly: true
        - name: envoy
          image: envoyproxy/envoy:latest
          args:
            - --config-path /etc/envoy/envoy.yaml
            - --service-cluster gateway
          volumeMounts:
            - name: envoy-config
              mountPath: /etc/envoy
      volumes:
        - name: policy-config
          configMap:
            name: tenant-policies
        - name: envoy-config
          emptyDir: {}
---
# (c) One-Namespace Test Manifest for Canary Rollout and Rollback
apiVersion: cnf.example/v1
kind: CanaryRolloutTest
metadata:
  name: tenant-a-canary-test
  namespace: tenant-a
spec:
  policyRef:
    name: tenant-a-api-v2
  testStages:
    - stage: baseline
      duration: 5m
      expectedWeight: 0
      checks:
        - type: metrics
          metric: requests_total{path="/api/v2"}
          condition: equals 0
    - stage: canary_10pct
      duration: 10m
      expectedWeight: 10
      checks:
        - type: http
          url: http://gateway.tenanta.svc/health
          expectSuccessRate: 0.95
        - type: metrics
          metric: envoy_cluster_upstream_rq_xx{cluster="backend-v2"}
          condition: exists
    - stage: canary_50pct
      duration: 10m
      expectedWeight: 50
      checks:
        - type: http
          url: http://gateway.tenanta.svc/api/v2/users
          expectSuccessRate: 0.99
    - stage: full_rollout
      duration: 5m
      expectedWeight: 100
      checks:
        - type: http
          url: http://gateway.tenanta.svc/api/v2/**
          expectSuccessRate: 0.999
  rollbackTest:
    enabled: true
    triggerFailureAt: canary_50pct
    expectedBehavior: weight_reverts_to_0_within_2m
```

## Why This Is Asked
This question assesses the ability to design token rotation mechanisms for multi-tenant CNF environments, focusing on atomic secret updates, race condition avoidance, and end-to-end validation.

## Key Concepts
- Ephemeral credentials with TTL management
- Atomic updates using compare-and-swap (CAS) patterns
- Kubernetes Secrets lifecycle management
- Observability of credential rotation events

## Code Example
```yaml
apiVersion: v1
kind: Secret
metadata:
  name: tenant-a-cred
  namespace: cnf-tenant-a
type: Opaque
data:
  token: <base64-encoded-token>
```
